title: TypedWorkflow
description: Paper §D.2 top-level workflow object. Byte-deterministic projection of `WorkflowDag`. The authoritative on-disk graph stays `WORKFLOW.json`; this is an additive, machine-checkable companion at `runtime/workflow-typed.json`.

atom_registry_snapshot_id.description: M4 — self-describing registry pin: the atom-registry snapshot id the composer planned against (`AtomRegistry::snapshot_id`). `None` when the producing path did not pin a snapshot (legacy / unpinned sessions). Never fabricated — a missing pin stays `None` so the artifact remains byte-reproducible across hosts.

name.description: Human-facing name. Today equals `workflow_id`; reserved for a distinct display label.

parameter_mappings.description: Port-level wiring projected from edges, sorted by `(target_step, target_input)`.

parameters.description: Top-level typed parameters (W4 — intake facts only), sorted by `name`.

validation_rules.description: Top-level validation rules (W4 — port/node constraints), sorted by `rule_id`.

ParameterMapping.description: Port wiring projected from an edge. Mirrors the edge endpoints but keyed for consumption ("what feeds this step's input").

TypedEdge.description: Paper §D.2 edge with full port-level endpoints (the data `lower_to_workflow_json` collapses into `depends_on`).

mutually_exclusive_group.description: T6.2 — `EdgeContract.mutually_exclusive_group`. When set, this edge is one member of a mutually-exclusive one-of input group; sibling members are ALTERNATIVES (only one is read at runtime, resolved to a single authoritative edge by observed-provenance in the RO-Crate). Preserved here so a generic consumer of `workflow-typed.json` sees the one-of structure — matching `proofs.jsonl` — and does NOT read an unread alternative as an authoritative data flow. `None` for ordinary edges.

TypedStep.description: Paper §D.2 step. `tool_id` is the source atom; `parameters` is a curated subset of `TaskNode.attributes` (method axes / required figures), NEVER a synthesized method choice (method-neutrality).

dependencies.description: Incoming `from_node`s, sorted + deduped. Equals the lowered `Task.depends_on` for this step (W6 asserts equality).

estimated_duration.description: Static `ResourceClass`-derived estimate in seconds. Deterministic lookup, NOT wall-clock.

parameters.description: Curated step parameters (sorted-key map). Empty for steps with no method/figure attributes.

tool_id.description: `TaskNode.attributes["atom_id"]` (the key the lowering reads). `None` when the node carries no atom id.

ValidationRule.description: Top-level validation rule (W4). Strictly richer than the paper: preserves the opaque CEL `expression` and the Hard/Soft/Warn `severity`. The compiler does NOT compile the expression — downstream consumers must not assume it is pre-validated.

expression.description: Opaque CEL/schema expression (uncompiled). `None` when the constraint declared no expression.

WorkflowMetadata.description: Paper §D.2 metadata (W3). All fields deterministic from compiler state.

complexity.description: Deterministic bucket from step count: `<5 simple / 5..=15 moderate / >15 complex`. NOT a calibrated metric — purely a size band.

tags.description: Sorted+deduped tag set (modality, project class, distinct TaskKind labels).

use_cases.description: Intake goal-pattern modifiers (sorted keys), e.g. `per-sample`, `with_pathway_enrichment`. Empty when no goal modifiers were captured.

WorkflowParameter.description: Top-level typed parameter (W4). Sourced ONLY from intake facts the SME supplied — organism/genome/sample counts — never a synthesized method.

source.description: Provenance of the value. Always `"intake"` for now.
